[engine] An instrument that has only ever run on the CONTROL arm does not license any statement about the arm under test, however directly it addresses the question.

<!-- lesson_id: eng-mh-0006 | class: measurement-hygiene | superseded_by: - -->

**class**: `measurement-hygiene`

## 為什麼（because）

The per-layer readback that 'exonerated the ids' ran in p25-keepleaf-dbg, whose defining property is that mul_mat_id consumes the HOST LEAF -- so it verified the gather's output inside a graph that does not consume the gather. That is a real measurement, but it is about a configuration the real arm never enters, and the same instrument on the real arm costs one arm in one sweep: p25-slotgpu-dbg prints leaf=[n/a] on every POST line (there is no leaf to compare against) yet still agrees with the hook's EXPECT on all 39 layers x 6 builds, which is the statement the earlier run was being quoted for. The cheap generality: when a probe needs a control arm to have something to compare against, that very fact means the result does not transfer; run the probe on both and say which one the number came from.
